variants.instructions: Give the star rating (1 to 5) that the reviewer most likely gave. Weigh the whole review: sarcasm, mixed praise and complaints, and how willing the reviewer is to buy again.
criteria: Product failed or was unusable; angry or sarcastic; would not recommend.
Mostly disappointed; one or two good points but main problems remain.
Mixed or lukewarm; strong good and bad points balance out.
Good with a small complaint; would recommend.
Delighted; no real complaints; strongly recommends.
